# qbitos{qbitos-kbatch} Compliance Baseline

## Compliance Root

- Canonical policy: https://github.com/qbitOS/compliance

## Runtime Path

`Prefixes (quantum-prefixes) -> DAC -> Steno -> .qbit -> Iron Line -> preflight`

KBatch sits at **Iron Line L4** (Notepad / Everything lane) and consumes **Gluelam** modules — see [docs/KBATCH_ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/KBATCH_ARCHITECTURE.md).

## Control Envelope

`Capsule graph / contrail / training channels / no forked prefix engines`
